recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. Future source changes should wait for FHIR-54853 or another final work-group decision that replaces the current R5-era dragon warning.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core search issue asking to clarify two :not behaviors: the effect of comma-separated OR values such as gender:not=male,female, and the effect of :not when a searched element can repeat, such as Observation.code. The approved resolution said modifiers apply to all OR values, added a dragon warning recommending _filter or named _queries for safety around or-joined :not terms, and added examples showing that any matching repetition excludes the resource.
initial_application: Git commit b18ebf425a07f0fd5c0e65cf54abce6847a19f1d, titled 'FHIR-40629 - Clarification of modifiers and or-joined parameter values.', applied the issue to source/search.html on 2023-03-20 by adding OR-value modifier prose, modifier table guidance, :not examples for missing/repeated values, and the dragon warning. The current source still contains those changes.
additional_context: The #implementers Zulip thread cited by the issue contains the same two ambiguities and records Gino Canessa's post-merge explanation that modifiers apply to each OR value while the :not comma-value case remained a feedback-requesting dragon warning. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-03-20 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote. Later issue FHIR-54853 is Triaged and unresolved for R6 and asks to finalize or remove the current warning, so it is not a final decision for this Applied/Published seed. source/search.html is active build content via publish.ini.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/search.html already says modifiers apply to each OR value, defines :not as returning resources that do not have any matching value in the searched elements, includes Patient and Composition examples covering missing values and repeated coded sections, and retains the dragon warning recommending _filter or Named Queries for or-joined :not search terms.

related_jiras.note: Triaged/unresolved R6 follow-up that quotes the current :not dragon warning and asks to finalize or prohibit or-joined :not behavior; not final enough to decide in this seed.
